description: What do held Fields and Indexes collections of a TableDef report after a column and an index were added in a level and the level rolled back, without and with Refresh? Fixture r-txn-1b-main-accdb (tables T, S, C, Lv, R, Wide, Big, saved QueryDef QInsMid), opened writable through DBEngine.OpenDatabase in Workspaces(0). Hold hfl = TableDefs('T').Fields and hix = TableDefs('T').Indexes; read both Count; BeginTrans; ALTER TABLE T ADD COLUMN Z LONG; CREATE INDEX IX_V ON T (V) (dbFailOnError); read both Count; Refresh both; read both Count; Rollback; DBEngine.Errors; read both Count; Refresh both; read both Count; close; catalog through a fresh Workspace.
retentionNote: Designed r-txn-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
